subject: architecture-meope-symbiosis

metrics.role: Intelligence and symbiosis layer — the brain that routes, plans, and learns
metrics.architecture: Not a new foundation model. Uses best available models per task (OOWM router + OLM brain).
capabilities: Ask — receive task from user or agent
Route — select best model for the task (local Ollama, frontier API, sovereign OWEM)
Check Safety — consult AGISafe before execution
Execute — run the task via selected model
Verify — check measurement against expected quality
Learn — update routing decisions based on outcomes
metrics.sakana_parallel: Sakana.ai uses evolutionary algorithms for AI symbiosis. meope.ai uses measurement-backed routing — same concept, but with independent verification.
metrics.defoneos_integration: DEFONEOS backing provides defense-AI compartment — sovereign, audit-grade, signed, neutral.
metrics.key_constraint: meope.ai can improve, but can't mark its own homework. CSOAI stays the independent measurement layer.

honest_sentence: meope.ai is the symbiosis layer: routes tasks to best available model, plans, checks safety, executes, measures, verifies, learns. Inspired by Sakana.ai but measurement-backed. Can improve, can't self-certify.
